author: Blasius, 1858
summary: 아고산대 침엽수림에 사는 나그네새로, 대개 나무 위에서 지낸다. 알은 6~8월에 4~5개 낳으며, 흰 바탕에 붉은 갈색과 엷은 자주색 얼룩점이 흩어져 있다.

art.subject: Arctic Warbler (Phylloscopus borealis), adult on passage (sexes alike): forehead to uppertail coverts dark greyish-olive; a long yellowish-white supercilium reaching well behind the eye and often slightly upturned at the rear; a dark olive eye-stripe; ear-coverts mottled olive and pale yellow; wings darker, with one thin whitish wing-bar on the greater coverts (sometimes a faint second); underparts whitish, washed pale yellow on the throat, centre of the breast and belly; breast sides and flanks greyish-olive; upper mandible dark brown, lower mandible yellowish-brown with a dusky tip; dark eye; pale yellowish-brown legs.
art.pose: foraging along a branch high in a conifer, side view
art.scene: Korean subalpine conifer forest on passage, fir and spruce branches; no people, buildings or text
views: adult, side view perched on a conifer branch: long yellowish-white supercilium, dark eye-stripe, dark greyish-olive upperparts, one thin whitish wing-bar, long primary projection, pale yellow-washed underparts with greyish-olive flanks, pale yellowish-brown legs

adult, head in profile: yellowish-white supercilium over a dark olive eye-stripe, ear-coverts mottled olive and pale yellow, dark brown upper mandible and yellowish-brown lower mandible with a dusky tip
art.build: Fairly large, robust leaf warbler, about 13cm — about sparrow length but much slimmer, and larger than Yellow-browed or Pallas's Leaf Warblers. Flat-crowned head and a relatively strong, pointed bill shorter than the head. Legs pale yellowish-brown. Wings long: at rest the primary tips project well beyond the tertials. Tail medium-length and square. Forages actively among foliage, usually high in trees.
avoid: Do not paint two bold wing-bars on a tiny, short-winged body — that is Yellow-browed Warbler (Phylloscopus inornatus); the Arctic Warbler shows one thin wing-bar.
Do not add a pale central crown stripe (Eastern Crowned Warbler, Phylloscopus coronatus).
Do not paint bright yellow underparts or blackish legs.
